posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
Nope it's intended.   Any come into play affects will be copied as well so Styles and Modes in play will be destroyed unless Fixed Point is out.   If you play Uh,Yeah, I'm That Guy on them and then they play a mode or style then they will be fine since Uh,Yeah, I'm That Guy doesn't have the style or mode keyword.  

 

Edit: He does like Legacy a lot with Inspiring Presense

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I don't get the card mimicking "when this card enters play" text.

The card entered play without that text on it, it is already in play when you give the chosen player a high five.  After you give the high five and copy the text the card is already in play.

It isn't an end or start of turn effect that can have multiple things occuring inside a phase, this is a singular event that triggers an effect.  It shouldn't trigger effects that didn't exist when it entered play.

 

If we are having copied text react as if the card just entered play then cards that react to cards entering play should react to themselves entering play.  Because that is the exact same timing.

Well, it's "because Christopher said so" really, but I can give a rationalization.

You decide to play Uh Yeah, I'm That Guy!

The card begins to enter play.

"When this card enters play, give another player a high-five. If you do, ..." - the card is entering play, so that happens.

Now Uh Yeah, I'm That Guy! has the text of, for instance, Inspiring Presence, including:

"When this card enters play, each hero target regains 1 HP." - the card is entering play, so that happens.

The card finishes entering play.

You continue on your merry way!

Because it doesn't have you play it next to a target, even though it copies that wording.  Apparently copying the text counts as the card entering play, but not as the card being played/put into play.

Well, it sort of does. The card has entered play, i.e. it was played. So it would ignore the effects that say "Play this card next to a target," because it has already been played. It's different than the effects that say "When this card enters play," because it is still in the process of entering play, but has already been played.

What we really need is an Ongoing card that says something like "When this card enters play, place it next to a target" to see what Uh Yeah, I'm That Guy does.
